content.text:
Added a Delete button to each task in `components/TaskList.tsx`.

What changed:
- Added `deleteTask(id)` to remove a task from state
- Updated each list item to show a `Delete` button
- Tweaked the row layout so checkbox/title and delete button sit neatly together

Note:
- I also tried `npm run lint`, but it failed because `next` isn’t installed in this environment (`sh: next: command not found`).

If you want, I can also restyle the delete button to look more like a danger action.
